title: Pendulum: the referee overturns the first answer
description: A 0.5 m pendulum swinging for 6.5 s. Three independent proposals and verification first accepted the undamped pendulum; a referee model then proposed linear damping, which forecast the held-out motion better, so the verdict changed. g = 9.91 ± 0.04 m/s² from the period, 1% above 9.81 (the length is the uploader's stated 0.5 m).
